newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Air France to rejig Nordic cargo operation.
newsitem.headline: Air France to rejig Nordic cargo operation.

text.p: Air France said on Wednesday it would temporarily adjust the schedule of its weekly Paris-Helsinki-Stockholm-Paris freight operation because of an aircraft shortage.
"As from January 23 we are operating on Thursday nights/Friday morning as opposed to Saturday/Sunday," Air France cargo manager Sweden Anders Forslund told Reuters.
"This is due to the fact we will be short of planes in February and March."
At the end of March Air France would resume its regular Saturday/Sunday schedule, Forslund said.
Since October 1995, Air France has been operating a Boeing 747-200F between Stockholm and Paris, adding a Helsinki stop to the route later because of a slowdown in volumes.
The French airline has been considering stepping up the frequency to two flights per week.
"Whether we will step up to a second frequency has not been decided yet. It depends on the market situation," Forslund said.
